summary: APPROVED. The impl correctly fixes all 3 root causes of the 7 Windows hook-e2e failures: (1) orch-gate / orch-gate-bash denial tests now use `startHookStub` (fast in-process HTTP) so the hook's 600ms timeouts don't fail-open against a slow live daemon; (2) subagent registration check switches from /state (requires ?workspace=, returns 400) to /agents (workspace-agnostic, searches by agent_id); (3) start-daemon.js test uses `runHookLong` (30s budget) so the hook's daemon-poll loop doesn't exhaust the default 8s spawnSync budget. One minor dead-code finding: `runHookWithStub` is defined but never called — benign, just unused. The daemon-curl exemption fix is sound: the test correctly reads `stubPort` from `bStub.env().ORCH_PORT` and passes it to the hook env so the port in the regex matches. All fixes are consistent with existing patterns in orch-gate.test.js. Automode merge verdict included.
